For even t or odd proper t, D_S has a nonzero linear coefficient and a triangular algebra automorphism sends it to one y_i; rank(D)=2^(n−1), rank(C)=half. For odd t=n=2m+1, multiplication descends to Q_m on even translations, conjugate to ω_m=Σu_jv_j; its tensor differential has 2^m homology dimensions, yielding rank 2^(2m−1)−2^(m−1). All quantifiers and exclusion n<3 are explicit. Independent exact F2 pivot elimination for all S, n3..7 confirms but is not the all-size proof.
